title: AiSuggestion
description: A natural-language pricing instruction, the AI's proposed config change (a JSON Patch against the current region config), and its full review trail. Nothing here ever touches a live config by itself — see design principle: 'AI suggests, interprets instructions, and explains — it never silently does arithmetic.' A suggestion becomes a new RegionPricingConfig version only via applySuggestion(), which re-validates against every non-negotiable (schema + FACTOR-basis rule) before it can go ACTIVE.

baseVersion.description: The config version this patch is diffed against.

instruction.description: The natural-language instruction as given by the user, verbatim.

proposedPatch.description: RFC 6902 JSON Patch operations against the RegionPricingConfig document.
